quantize_model_4w: quantize a pytorch model linear layers with 4-bit weight-only quantization using group size 32
quantize_model_8w: quantize a pytorch model linear layers with 8-bit weight-only quantization using per-axis granularity
quantize_model_8da4w: quantize a pytorch model with 8-bit dynamic activation and 4-bit weight quantization on linear layers
quantize_model_embedding: quantize a pytorch model embedding layers with 4-bit or 8-bit weight-only quantization
quantize_model_fallback: quantize a pytorch model with a primary group quantization config and a fallback per-axis config for incompatible layers
